title: 90-Minute The Capital Tour
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Not recommended for people with mobility issues.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Tour Victoria in a fun, unique and relaxing way -- by horse-drawn carriage! Your experienced, uniformed driver will navigate Victoria's streets and show you amazing views of the historic James Bay neighborhood, the Dallas Road waterfront, Victoria's spectacular Inner Harbor, and more. Routes subject to change.
